verdict.rationale: The S&E API docs confirm you can set up budgets, users, and virtual cards (docs-2), and marketing says every transaction is 'controlled' and 'automatically compliant' (docs-9). Custom approval policies exist, but the documented approval policy covers AP bills, not card spend (docs-7, docs-39). Nothing explicitly shows budgets assigned to teams or projects, or card limits and approvals enforcing those budgets. Missing for 10: documented allocation of budgets to teams/projects, explicit card spend limits tied to budgets, approval enforcement on card/expense spend (not just AP bills), hands-on or independent corroboration.
